name: plate
author: LizardMan
description: A plate reverb in the effect list, with a shift layer. Its page draws the reverb as a stack of waveforms in 3D, the way it is heard: the dry sound in front, then six listening points behind it in the order the sound reaches them, with an icon for each knob along the top. The settings "copies" (three echoes of the rows under the stack; off makes the page lighter) and "wave amplitude". It rests once its tail is over, so a plate on silence costs next to nothing, and its knobs move smoothly.
